en: "At first, I thought it was just a rumor born of the Board Chair's enormous magic power."{w}{p}"But the other day...{w}Someone had cleverly tried to hide it, but..."{w}{p}"I sensed as many as two {11:0001:0015} in the narrow sense going off at the same time.{w}...From the middle of the 3rd floor, no less."{w}
note: 'It had been cleverly hidden': source drops who hid it (implied the Board Chair, who is only suspected); kept passive. 'in the narrow sense' matches the lecture/exam term in slices 054/056. No plural -s after the spell insert. | Accuracy: source is 'was trying to hide it cleverly' (an attempt that failed, since Soara sensed it); 'had been cleverly hidden' lost the attempt. Hider left as 'someone' (only the Board Chair is suspected).

en: "I respect the Board Chair.{w}The Chair should know better than anyone how terrifying the power that spells bring can be!"{w}

"I want to know.{w}Why the Chair would take a risk like that.{w}What the point of it is."{w}{p}"I tried telling my teacher, but I wasn't believed.{w}It's a cover-up even Vice Principal Kathleen can't detect.{w}I feel like something terrible is about to happen..."{w}{p}"I'll try once more to persuade my teacher.{w}You get the way to the Board Chair's Office ready.{w}It should be reachable from the back of the Principal's Office."{w}{p}"If the Principal comes at you oinking, then... just kick him aside.{w}I'm counting on you."{w}
note: 'my teacher': most likely Professor Scheherazade (Soara pleads with that teacher in 37003), but the line does not name them, so left unnamed and genderless.

en: Better hurry to the Principal's Office.{w}
"Hi there!{w}How've you been?"{w}
"Come to think of it, you were saying something about Miria, weren't you...?"{w}
You told Soara that Miria is worried about where she's gone.{w}
"I see..."{w}
"Okay, I'll go show my face!{w}I feel like right now, I could face Miria with my head held high."{w}
"Only... I need to get myself ready first...{w}So go on ahead to the Training Hall in Bistel.{w}I'll catch up with you later."{w}
Soara is twirling round and round in front of the full-length mirror, holding up outfits.{w}
"Miria, huh...{w}It's been so long...{w}Miria'll be floored when I say I was top of my class. *giggle*"{w}
note: Miria's gender unknown: sentence built to avoid a pronoun.

en: Professor Scheherazade
note: Glossary form, 22 chars: over the ~16 name-box limit (glossary suggests a 'Prof.' short form may be needed).

en: "Oh my, welcome.{w}Will it be a lesson? An exam?{w}Or maybe... ex-tra... les-sons?"{w}
note: Parody of the newlywed 'dinner? bath? or... me?' line; the source spells out 'hoshuu' (extra/remedial lessons) syllable by syllable.

en: Take the Year 1 Completion Exam?
note: Exam name follows slice 055 ('2nd-Year Completion Exam').

en: "Sure, I'll give you a lit-tle test~"{w}
note: Syllable-split teasing in the source rendered as 'lit-tle'.

en: "...Well done, you pass!{w}This is where your spell studies really begin. So put your heart into it and do your best."{w}

[Key Item]
You obtained the Year 1 Certificate.{w}

en: "No good at all.{w}Are you actually studying?"{w}{p}"Enjoying student life is fine and all, but you need to do what you're supposed to do, understand?{w}Come back when you're ready, you silly thing."{w}
"Oh my, there's no need to be scared, you know~?"{w}
"...The Year 1 Completion Exam.{w}Let's begin."{w}
When Professor Scheherazade closed their eyes, an anti-cheating barrier went up.{w}
note: Professor's gender unknown: 'their eyes'.

en: "The Board Chair?{w}Even if you tell me that..."{w}
"Please, Professor!{w}Please lend me your help!"{w}
"Hmmm...{w}Oh, Soara dear...{w}Have you gotten a little bigger?"{w}

en: "Kyan!?{w}Wh-where do you think you're touching!!"{w}
"Worrying about students is a teacher's job, isn't it?{w}You're such a flat little thing, Soara dear, I can't help worrying..."{w}
"M-mind your own business!!"{w}
Persuading the professor is proving difficult...{w}

note: Centred banner; spacing approximates the source. 'Career Guidance Office' follows slice 051 (2771). In-game check.

en: "Helloooo~{w}So you all want to become good little kids, do you~?{w}That's fine~ just leave it all to your teacher~"{w}
Let's be good little kids~
"I'll teach you nice and gently~"{w}
Who will receive guidance?
"Now then, close your eyes~{w}Badness, badness, fly awaaay~~~!"{w}
note: Star symbol dropped (slice 053 renders it as '!').

en: "Yaaay~ From today on, you're a good little kid~ Hooray~"{w}
"Eeeeeh~ Professor Harmoni is very, very sad~{w}*mope*..."{w}
"Huh~?{w}Huh, huh~~~?"{w}
"What's up, Harmoni?"{w}
"Something smells good~{w}I smell some rare sweets~"{w}
"You, that again?{w}Isn't your head just stuffed full of sugar?"{w}
"You all, over there~{w}Show me what's in your pockets, please~!{w}It's a belongings checky-check~!"{w}
note: Cutesy hiragana 'chekku': 'checky-check'.

"H-hey! Don't go touching other people's stuff without asking!"{w}
"Found it, a Mont Blanc~!{w}Ummm~...{w}Can I confiscate this~?"{w}
note: Mont Blanc as in slices 051/053.

en: "Confiscate, nothing -- you just want to eat it!{w}Show some restraint, you're a teacher, dammit!!"{w}
"Uuu~{w}There's no such word as 'restraint' for Professor Harmoni~{w}Please try to understand~"{w}
"Yeah, yeah.{w}...You lot don't have to bother with this one.{w}Go on, get out of here."{w}
note: Harmoni's gender unknown, so 'this one' rather than 'her'.

en: "Y-your teacher~ has a grenade, you know~! I really do have one, you knooow~~~?"{w}
note: Harmoni refers to self as 'teacher'.

en: "A teacher doesn't threaten students!!{w}Snatching a student's snack away from them is the lowest of the low! You're way more of a bad one than I am!!"{w}
note: 'waru' = 'bad one' as in slice 053.

en: "Uuuu~~~"{w}
"Wh-what is it..."{w}
"Professor Warmoni~{w}Professor Harmoni's been a little sad lately~{w}Lately, Professor Warmoni..."{w}
note: Sentence cut across rows; continues in 2914.

en: "...isn't bad one bit~"{w}
"At first, your attitude was bad~{w}But now you've gone and become a good teacher to the students~"{w}
"N-now that you mention it... I...!?"{w}

"We promised, didn't we~? Professor Harmoni would raise good little kids, and Professor Warmoni would raise bad little kids~"{w}{p}"Where did the fierce, glaring Professor Warmoni of that day go off to~?{w}Professor Harmoni is all mopey~"{w}
"...Truth is~, Professor Warmoni wants to eat the Mont Blanc too, right~?"{w}
